# Code of conduct

Treat contributors as peers. Be welcoming to people with different experience levels, languages, and access needs. Discuss technical choices using evidence and give credit for contributions.

Harassment, discrimination, threats, impersonation, and publishing someone's private information are unacceptable in project spaces.

Report an incident privately to the maintainer using the contact options on [the maintainer's GitHub profile](https://github.com/EnesKeremAYDIN). Share only the details needed for follow-up. The maintainer can remove content, restrict participation, or refer a report to the hosting platform. Reports should be handled with discretion and without retaliation.

For suspected software vulnerabilities, follow the [security policy](SECURITY.md).
